q: What are the emissions from building a power transmission line per km?
title: Building a transmission line: per km
short: Most of the footprint is materials: galvanised steel towers, aluminium conductors and concrete foundations, which are Scope 3 capital goods. Site work adds diesel for cranes, winches and trucks, at 2.68 kg CO2 per litre. Divide by km built.

ul: ACSR or aluminium conductor, by tonnes.

p: Exported steel structures and aluminium conductors can be CBAM goods. A line built in India is not.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
